answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond in a shared escrow meadow before it can earn: the bond is slashed on proven fraud and only released after a long season of honest work. A vine of mutual attestations links each newcomer to established sponsors who stake their own reputation alongside it, so one bad actor poisons the sponsor's standing too. Add a velvet-soft entry cost - a small, non-refundable, time-locked fee per identity - so spawning ten thousand fakes costs ten thousand fees, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back.
